fields.System.Title: INT-305 — Projection reconciliation jobs
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want every projection checked against its source on a schedule, so
that drift is detected rather than served to customers.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given each projection, then a scheduled job compares it against the source and reports
  • every mismatch.
  • - Given availability, then it reconciles hourly; reporting projections reconcile
  • nightly.
  • - Given a mismatch, then an alert reaches a person and the rebuild is offered — but not
  • run automatically.
  • - Given a projection row older than its freshness threshold, then it is reported as
  • stale even when the value matches.
  • - Given a reconciliation job that fails to run, then that also alerts.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, inventory, outbound |
| Tables | all projections |
| Risks | Projection drift ([doc 08 §10](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)); auto-correcting hides the cause ([doc 08 §9](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
